comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper opening stop versus uncover clean ice, scoop it, and deliver it hygienically.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial tool seating and counterholding; the ice task requires lid removal, scoop loading, granular transport, source selection, and contamination avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained angle across three cycles; the ice task requires at least one clean-source cube settled in the bowl with scoop use and no contamination.
comparison.reason: Tool use and release are shared only at a generic level; the board task tests hygienic source-dependent scooping rather than adjustment locking.
